mapper.select: SELECT f.*, u.user_name AS chief_name, ft.facility_type_name FROM facility f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.facility_chief_id = u.id LEFT JOIN facility_type ft ON f.facility_type = ft.facility_type_id WHERE f.facility_check_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(f.facility_check_time, INTERVAL f.facility_expiration_date MONTH) <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) ORDER BY DATE_ADD(f.facility_check_time, INTERVAL f.facility_expiration_date MONTH) ASC
